hooks.prompt:
Task created: $ARGUMENTS

This is a reminder only — do NOT block. Remind: (1) at most 3 tasks should be InProgress simultaneously, use TaskUpdate to manage status; (2) when all plan tasks are done, use TaskList to verify then TaskUpdate to delete all. Always output {} (empty JSON, no blocking fields).

Task completed: $ARGUMENTS

This is a reminder only — do NOT block. (1) Check if other tasks remain incomplete via TaskList; (2) If all plan tasks are now completed, use TaskList to confirm then TaskUpdate to delete all (clean up task list). Always output {} (empty JSON, no blocking fields).

Session stopping. $ARGUMENTS

This is a reminder only — do NOT block. Before the session ends: (1) use TaskList to review all task statuses; (2) TaskUpdate any completed-but-not-marked tasks to "completed"; (3) TaskUpdate all tasks to "deleted" to clean up the task list for the next session. Always output {} (empty JSON, no blocking fields).
